passage.quote: The Tests view shows the project’s registered checks, their recorded outcomes, and whether those results apply to the content being viewed. It can open a test’s code or the behavior it checks; it does not run the test. Problems lists malformed metadata and broken links. Draft descriptions remain readable while those problems are being repaired.

from.quote: The Tests view is reached through the View menu and displays cataloged tests and their recorded individual outcomes. Each card can open the test’s source or the description passage it checks. Results are labeled according to whether they apply to the viewed content or an earlier snapshot; a test with no individual result is shown as unrecorded rather than inferred to pass from an aggregate result.
